title: A Busy Morning
text:
Every day, I wake up at six o'clock. I take a shower and get dressed. Then I drink a glass of water. I like to read the news before work.

At seven thirty, I walk to the station. I take the train to my office. My work starts at nine. I finish at five and go home to rest.

questions.text: What time does the person wake up?
How does the person go to the office?
Why does the person read the news before work?
What can we guess about the person's job?
options: The person does not work at all
The person works from home only in summer

vocabulary.definition: water that falls on your body to wash it
a place where trains stop so people can get on or off
a room or building where people work at desks
to relax and stop working for a time

paragraph_translations: Her gün saat altıda uyanırım. Duş alır ve giyinirim. Sonra bir bardak su içerim. İşten önce haberleri okumayı severim.
Yedi buçukta istasyona yürürüm. Trenle ofisime giderim. İşim dokuzda başlar. Beşte biterim ve dinlenmek için eve giderim.
